title: Vertical Presets & Multi-Look UI
description: Reusable LookProvider (Storefront / Scheduler / Ledger Pro) and VerticalProvider presets (escrow, barber, florist, saas) for Next.js.
notes: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_VERTICAL=barber|florist|saas|escrow in apps/web/.env to pick the default business vertical.
